summary.name: SANE git repositories
summary.one_liner: Git access page for the SANE (Scanner Access Now Easy) project, listing the public repositories for the sane-backends, sane-frontends and website code hosted on GitLab.
use_cases: clone the latest unreleased SANE scanner code
browse a single SANE source file online
contribute a patch to SANE backends
get SANE git repositories for development
summary.what_it_does: The page explains how to access the SANE project's git repositories, which are being moved to GitLab.com. Anonymous read-only access is available over HTTPS for three repositories: backends (the main SANE libraries and all backends), frontends (including graphical frontends), and website. Developers can get SSH access after requesting permission on GitLab. Each repository can also be browsed through the GitLab web tree view without cloning. The page also gives contribution rules, such as writing descriptive commit messages and asking on the sane-devel list before major changes.
notable: Three repositories: backends, frontends and website, hosted on gitlab.com/sane-project
Anonymous HTTPS clone; SSH access for developers after requesting group access
Commit messages feed the release ChangeLog automatically
caveats: Code in git is untested and carries a higher risk of bugs than stable releases
The project is relocating to GitLab.com, so URLs may change
Development SSH access requires a request and approval on GitLab
